name: Sprinter
description: A dynamic running figure built from bold ellipses capturing the energy of a full sprint.

name: Orbital
description: Circles in orbit around a glowing centre, exploring mass and gravity through geometry.

name: Bloom
description: Six ellipses rotating around a dark centre, forming a radiant geometric flower.

name: Cyclist
description: A minimalist cycling figure assembled from circles and ellipses in a clean light style.

name: Node
description: An interconnected graph of nodes and edges — structure and connection made visible.

name: Strata
description: Rectangles stacked in receding layers — an abstract study in depth and proportion.

name: Pulse
description: Concentric rings pulsing outward from a central point, frozen in the moment of expansion.

name: Helix
description: Two intertwined elliptical paths tracing a double helix structure in clean outline.

name: Vortex
description: Ellipses spiralling inward in a rotational dance, creating the illusion of depth and motion.

name: Archer
description: A figure in full draw — bow, arrow and body tension captured in minimal geometry.

name: Lattice
description: A repeating grid of diamonds and lines forming a structural lattice pattern.

name: Dune
description: Soft arcs layered like wind-sculpted dunes — nature reduced to its simplest curves.

name: Prism
description: A geometric prism refracting imaginary light — angular faces in precise outline.

name: Jumper
description: An athletic figure mid-jump, arms raised, momentum frozen in geometric form.

name: Wave
description: Sinusoidal waves stacked in harmonics — rhythm and repetition in minimal line work.

name: Capsule
description: Rounded rectangles nested and offset, creating a satisfying pill-shaped composition.

name: Crystal
description: Angular facets of a crystal rendered in precise outline, each face catching imaginary light.

name: Rings
description: Five interlocked rings in the classic formation — unity and connection as pure geometry.

name: Leaf
description: A single leaf reduced to its essential geometry — midrib, veins and organic silhouette.

name: Axis
description: Three-dimensional axes rendered flat — the foundation of every coordinate system.
